description: [PAID $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] LLM translation (Meta Llama 4 Scout on Workers AI, M2M100 fallback). Give `text`, or a `url` whose main content is extracted as Markdown and translated in blocks, preserving Markdown formatting, URLs and code blocks. Source language auto-detected (or set `from`). Up to 20,000 chars per call (default 8,000). All params optional: with none it translates a short Spanish sample to English. Languages: en,es,fr,de,it,pt,nl,ru,uk,pl,cs,ro,hu,el,bg,sv,da,no,fi,tr,ar,he,fa,hi,bn,ur,ta,zh,ja,ko,vi,th,id,ms,tl,sw.

text.description: Text or Markdown to translate (optional). If omitted and no url, a short Spanish sample is used.

to.description: Target language, ISO 639-1 code or English name (default "en").

url.description: Public http(s) URL whose main content is translated (optional; used when `text` is absent).

name: translate
title: Translate text or web page
